# [EPIC] Frontend Modernisation: CRA → Vite + React 19 + dependency refresh

## Epic
Migrate the Filmpire React app off the deprecated Create React App (CRA / react-scripts) toolchain onto Vite, upgrade React to v19, upgrade all major dependencies to their current compatible versions, and restore a clean, passing build with no known vulnerabilities above low severity.

## Business Value
CRA is unmaintained (last release 2022) and produces 15 known audit findings on the current dependency tree. Running on React 17 and react-router-dom v5 means the app is three major versions behind. Migrating to Vite gives sub-second HMR, a supported toolchain, and aligns the frontend with 2026 ecosystem expectations.

## Product Goal alignment
Serves the Product Goal (docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md) by ensuring the platform's client application is maintainable, secure, and developer-friendly going forward.

## Notes
Complete. Frontend now runs on Vite 8 + Vitest, React 19, react-router-dom 7, RTK 2, MUI 6, with a clean `npm audit` (0 findings at every severity) and a green CI pipeline. `@mui/styles` (no React-19-compatible release) was migrated to `tss-react/mui` as part of #123. One known, separately tracked gap: 2 tests in `media.test.js` are skipped pending #132 (a pre-existing jsdom hang, unrelated to any of this epic's changes).
